source.title: Online Learning: A Modern Introduction Using Convex Optimization
source.anchor: Chapter 2 forward remark on printed page 14 (PDF 26). Section 5.2, Theorem 5.4 and its affine witness on printed pages 52–53 (PDF 64–65).

target: For each nontrivial finite-dimensional real inner product space, alpha in (0,1) and natural T satisfying T >= 2/((1-alpha)phi(alpha)), there exists a horizon-dependent real loss sequence satisfying played-round regularity and the zero-comparator regret bound on the actual full-space variable-step OGD run from zero. Read t+1 for source rounds. Regret is the sum of pre-update losses.

semantic_roundtrip.remaining_semantic_delta: Choose one unit direction, take first ceil(T/2) losses with negative slope and remaining floor(T/2) positive. Actual gradient and canonical affine OSD support agree; actual iterateVariable and OSD iterate agree by induction, their regret by summing. Apply prior OSD switching_vector_lower_bound, preserving phi/2 and exponent 2-alpha. The original theorem is for OSD and the new declaration transfers on the chosen differentiable witness. Source alpha-left-limit is separate from growth over horizons.
